value.rationale: The modulo-p-squared extension of a published isolated prime-index congruence to the entire natural base-p digit-boundary class identifies the exact linear first-order correction. Its structural support lemma explains why carries from adjacent p-blocks vanish, and it gives an explicit prime-power tower, rather than an arbitrary numerical subcase.
